SELECT FROM ams_waiting_list WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT w.*, u.nickname as customer_name, u.username as customer_phone, s.name as service_name, t.real_name as tech_name FROM ams_waiting_list w LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON w.customer_id = u.id LEFT JOIN ams_service s ON w.service_id = s.id LEFT JOIN ams_technician_info t ON w.tech_id = t.user_id WHERE w.customer_id = #{customerId} ORDER BY w.create_time DESC
